headline: Bank of Jamaica Results for 30-Day Certificate of Deposit Auction
summary: The Bank of Jamaica opened and allocated JMD 32 billion of 6.25% fixed-rate 30-day certificates of deposit through a competitive price auction.
why: Central bank open-market operations manage domestic liquidity and signal short-term monetary policy stances.

impacts.name: Bank of Jamaica 30-day CD rate
impacts.why: Central bank certificate of deposit auctions establish short-term benchmark yields for local currency liquidity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
